exercises.title: Daily Conversation at Coffee Shop
exercises.transcript: Welcome to our coffee shop! How can I help you? I'd like a large cappuccino, please. Would you like that for here or to go? For here, please. That's $4.50. Here you go. Thank you! Enjoy your coffee!

exercises.title: Job Interview Introduction
exercises.transcript: Thank you for coming in today. Can you tell me about yourself? Of course. I graduated from university five years ago. I've been working in marketing since then. What are your strengths? I'm very organized and creative. I work well under pressure.

exercises.title: Business Meeting Discussion
exercises.transcript: Let's discuss the quarterly results. Overall, we've exceeded our targets. Our revenue increased by 15% compared to last quarter. However, we faced some challenges in the Asian market. I'd like to propose a new strategy for expansion. What are your thoughts on this approach?

exercises.title: Asking for Directions
exercises.transcript: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the train station? Sure, go straight down this street. Turn left at the traffic light. It's about a five-minute walk. Thank you so much! You're welcome!

exercises.title: Making a Restaurant Reservation
exercises.transcript: Good evening, Golden Restaurant. How can I help you? I'd like to make a reservation for two people, please. What date and time would you prefer? This Saturday at 7 PM. Perfect. Could I have your name and phone number?
